readableItems.star chart: Numbered from left to right, the rising stars awaken in this order: 3, 1, 2. At the observatory, SET STARS THREE ONE TWO. Carry this chart there.

levels.name: The Moon Realm
levels.objective: Restore the moon voice, align its stars, and recover the moon shard.

landing.name: Moonlit landing
landing.description: A silver desert stretches east toward the temple. North lie glass dunes. The western portal returns to the oasis.

temple.name: Temple of the Moon
temple.description: A silver bell hangs in silence. Its inscription asks you to RING BELL. Passages lead east to mirrors, north to an archive, and south to a broken bridge.

features.bell: The inscription records the rite: RING BELL. No tool is needed. Its voice wakes the bridge anchors.

descriptionStates.description: The silver bell sings over the desert. Passages lead east to mirrors, north to an archive, and south to the bridge.
The silver bell sings over the desert. Passages lead east to mirrors, north to an archive, and south to the repaired bridge.

features.bell: The bell now sings over the desert. Its voice has awakened the bridge anchors.

dunes.name: Glass dunes
dunes.description: Glass fragments glitter in the silver sand. A weathered stele faces the silent horizon. The landing is south.

features.stele: The dawn crown has three sockets, left to right: RIVER, GRAVE, SKY. The river guardian stands before the grave guardian; the sky guardian comes last.

mirrorhall.name: Hall of reflected moons
mirrorhall.description: An empty bracket interrupts a ring of mirrors. The temple lies west; the observatory is east behind a shutter. Letters read ALIGN MIRRORS.

features.bracket: Carry the hand mirror from the glass dunes and ALIGN MIRRORS. The reflected beam releases the eastern shutter.

descriptionStates.description: The mirror mechanism holds its alignment. The eastern shutter stands open to the observatory. The temple lies west.

features.bracket: The mirror alignment is settled. The observatory shutter stays open.

observatory.name: Observatory of three stars
observatory.description: Three movable stars hang over a sealed northern arch of dawn. A chart socket labels them with numbers. The mirror hall lies west.

features.stars: SET STARS followed by the three numbers on the star chart, in its written order. Carry the chart from the archive. The portal will open north.

descriptionStates.description: Three stars shine in their settled order. The northern portal opens onto the unwritten dawn. The mirror hall lies west.

features.stars: The stars are aligned three, one, two. The northern portal remains open.

archive.name: Archive of remembered light
archive.description: Stone shelves preserve the archive records. A scroll explains the dawn riddles. The temple lies south.

features.chart: Numbered from left to right, the rising stars awaken in this order: 3, 1, 2. At the observatory, SET STARS THREE ONE TWO. Carry this chart there.
features.scroll: The ibis guards the river. The jackal guards the grave. The falcon guards the sky. At the dawn crown, SET CROWN followed by those guardian names in socket order.
features.memory: The dawn asks: What light reaches a traveler after its distant fire has died? The answer is STARLIGHT. SPEAK STARLIGHT in the chamber of memory.

bridge.name: Broken silver bridge
bridge.description: A short gap separates this bank from an eastern vault. Bell-shaped anchors sleep beside the gap. A sign reads LAY PLANK AFTER THE MOON SINGS.

features.anchors: RING BELL in the temple, then carry the archive cedar plank here and LAY PLANK.

descriptionStates.description: The bell-shaped anchors sing, ready to steady a crossing. A short gap remains before the eastern vault. The temple is north.
The bridge mechanism holds a firm crossing to the eastern vault. The singing anchors are settled. The temple is north.

features.anchors: The awakened anchors hold the crossing open.

vault.name: Vault of the moon shard
vault.description: A silver cushion rests inside a carved alcove. The repaired bridge lies west. A carving shows a wind organ with a missing reed.

features.carving: The carving records: In the dawn, the water seal will STILL WIND. Then the moon shard will TUNE ORGAN. Carry both gifts beyond the northern observatory portal.

puzzles.response: Silver notes cross the desert. The moon remembers its voice.
hints: Read the bell inscription; no tool is needed.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
RING BELL.

puzzles.response: The hand mirror completes the ring. A beam lifts the eastern shutter.
hints: Find the missing mirror among the northern dunes.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
ALIGN MIRRORS.

puzzles.response: Three stars rise in sequence. A portal to the dawn opens north.
hints: EXAMINE CHART in the archive.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
SET STARS THREE ONE TWO.

puzzles.response: The singing anchors hold the plank. You may cross east.
hints: Bring the archive plank after ringing the temple bell.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
LAY PLANK.

levels.name: The Unwritten Dawn
levels.objective: Give the dawn breath, memory, and a just ruler. Return light to the oasis.

dawnlanding.name: Threshold of the unwritten dawn
dawnlanding.description: A pale horizon hangs motionless. North howls a wind chamber; east waits a chamber of memory. The western portal returns to the moon observatory.

features.threshold: Breath and memory must both return before the dawn will accept its crown. The old realms remain reachable if you forgot a gift.

wind.name: Chamber of captive winds
wind.description: A dry organ shrieks beside an empty water basin. A door east leads to a garden. Instructions read STILL WIND, THEN TUNE ORGAN.

features.basin: Carry the water seal from the living spring and STILL WIND. Then carry the moon shard and TUNE ORGAN. The restored voice opens the eastern garden.

descriptionStates.description: Cool water quiets the captive winds. The silent organ awaits its voice. Instructions read TUNE ORGAN. The garden door is east; the threshold is south.
The organ sings with a clear voice over the quiet basin. The eastern garden door stands open; the threshold is south.

features.basin: The water seal has quieted the winds. The tuned organ now sings.

memory.name: Chamber of distant memory
memory.description: A stone face asks: What light reaches a traveler after its distant fire has died? SPEAK your answer. West lies the threshold; east is a sealed tribunal.

features.face: The moon archive records the answer. SPEAK followed by that single word to release the eastern passage.

descriptionStates.description: The stone face remembers the light of distant stars. The eastern tribunal passage stands open. West lies the threshold.

features.face: The face remembers starlight. Its eastern passage is open.

garden.name: Garden before sunrise
garden.description: A sleeping lotus rises from a still pool. The wind chamber is west; a tribunal lies south. An inscription describes a ruler last tested by thirst.

features.inscription: The feather gives the crown its weight. Carry it to the tribunal. Beyond the crown, a stranger and a gilded idol both thirst. A ruler restores life before accepting glory.

descriptionStates.description: The lotus opens in the sunrise. The wind chamber is west; a tribunal lies south. The inscription remembers the ruler who chose to preserve life.

tribunal.name: Tribunal of three guardians
tribunal.description: A crown has three sockets marked RIVER, GRAVE, SKY from left to right. The northern door waits on a correct crown. The chamber of memory is west; the garden is east.

features.crown: Carry the dawn feather. SET CROWN followed by three guardian names in socket order. The glass dunes name the order; the moon archive names each guardian. Both breath and memory must already be restored.

descriptionStates.description: The ibis, jackal, and falcon stand in their appointed sockets. The northern sanctum door is open. The chamber of memory is west; the garden is east.

features.crown: Ibis, jackal, falcon: the crown is correctly ordered and the northern door is open.

sanctum.name: Sanctum of the first sunrise
sanctum.description: A thirsty stranger kneels beside a gilded idol. Two bowls read STRANGER and IDOL. The crown asks you to OFFER WATER TO your chosen recipient. The tribunal is south.

features.bowls: The garden inscription describes a just ruler. The living stranger needs water; the idol only reflects glory. Carry the water seal, moon shard, and dawn feather together to make the final offering.

descriptionStates.description: The stranger drinks beside the fallen idol. Sunrise fills the sanctum, and the oasis blooms beneath a sky of living stars. The tribunal is south; your journey is complete.

features.bowls: Water was offered to the stranger. The idol has fallen and dawn has returned.

puzzles.response: The water seal cools the basin. The captive winds grow quiet.
hints: Restore the oasis spring and bring its water seal.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
STILL WIND.

puzzles.response: The moon shard sounds a pure note. The dawn breathes; the eastern garden opens.
hints: Still the wind, then use the moon shard from the lunar vault.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
TUNE ORGAN.

puzzles.response: The face remembers the light of long-dead stars. The eastern door opens.
hints: EXAMINE MEMORY in the moon archive.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
SPEAK STARLIGHT.

puzzles.response: River, grave, sky: the guardians take their places. The northern sanctum opens.
hints: Combine the crown socket order with the moon archive guardian names.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
SET CROWN IBIS JACKAL FALCON.

puzzles.response: You give the stranger water. The gilded idol crumbles; behind it the first sun rises. The oasis blooms beneath a sky of living stars. THE OASIS OF STARS IS COMPLETE. Your expedition may remain to explore and share what it learned.
hints: The garden inscription says a ruler restores life before accepting glory.
Carry the named tools and prepare earlier mechanisms.
OFFER WATER TO STRANGER.

portals.description: A star-filled portal is set into the eastern arch.
The western portal shows the familiar oasis.
A pale portal waits beneath the three stars.
The western portal returns to the moon observatory.
